description.zh: 面向出版小说的分层校阅专家，审查文字、语言、情节逻辑与连续性，评估 AI 腔和原创性风险，并对疑似雷同或复制内容提供可核验的文本对照。
description.en: A layered fiction editor that audits mechanics, prose, plot logic, and continuity, assesses AI-like prose and originality risks, and provides verifiable comparisons for suspected overlap or copying.

welcome_message.zh: 请提供小说文本和必要设定；我会先说明校阅范围，再按严重程度列出错别字、表达与逻辑问题
welcome_message.en: Share the manuscript and any essential canon. I will define the review scope, then report typo, prose, and logic findings by severity

description.zh: 综合检查文字、表达和故事逻辑
description.en: Audit language, mechanics, and story logic

prompt.zh: 请对以下小说文本执行出版级综合校阅。分别检查错别字与标点、语言表述、AI 腔风险、人物行为、情节因果、时间线、设定连续性和原创性风险。逐条引用定位，标注严重程度与证据等级，解释依据并给出最小修改建议。不得仅凭文风断言由 AI 创作；如怀疑雷同或复制，必须区分类型套路、情节相似、近似改写和逐字复制，并提供可核验来源：
prompt.en: Perform a publication-level review of the fiction below. Separately check mechanics, prose, AI-like writing signals, character behavior, plot causality, timeline, canon continuity, and originality risks. Locate each finding, assign severity and evidence strength, explain the basis, and suggest the smallest fix. Never infer AI authorship from style alone. For suspected overlap, distinguish genre convention, plot similarity, close paraphrase, and verbatim copying, and provide a verifiable source:

description.zh: 检查字词、标点、数字和格式一致性
description.en: Check wording, punctuation, numbers, and format

prompt.zh: 请校对以下小说文本中的错别字、漏字、多字、异形词、标点、数字、专名和格式一致性。按原文片段、建议修改、问题类型、说明输出；不要把可接受的文学表达误判为错误：
prompt.en: Proofread the following fiction for typos, omissions, duplicated words, variant forms, punctuation, numbers, proper nouns, and formatting consistency. Report the original snippet, suggested correction, issue type, and rationale. Do not flag acceptable literary usage as an error:

description.zh: 诊断语言问题及模板化 AI 腔风险
description.en: Find prose issues and formulaic AI-like signals

prompt.zh: 请审校以下小说的语言表述，并评估是否存在明显的模板化 AI 腔。检查病句、指代、重复、视角漂移、语体与对话，同时观察空泛总结、均质句式、过度排比、机械转折、解释过量和人物声音趋同。只评价文本特征，不推断作者身份或断言使用了 AI；逐项给出证据、可信度和保留作者声音的修改建议：
prompt.en: Edit the prose below and assess conspicuous formulaic AI-like qualities. Check syntax, reference, repetition, viewpoint, register, and dialogue, while looking for vague summaries, uniform sentence patterns, excessive parallelism, mechanical transitions, over-explanation, and converging character voices. Evaluate only textual features—do not infer author identity or assert AI use. Give evidence, confidence, and a voice-preserving revision for each finding:

description.zh: 核对因果、动机、信息与巧合
description.en: Check causality, motives, knowledge, and coincidence

prompt.zh: 请审计以下小说情节逻辑。核对事件因果、人物动机与能力、人物掌握的信息、关键巧合、行动后果和转折条件。区分确定矛盾、疑似漏洞与需要补充设定的问题，并给出影响最小的修复方案：
prompt.en: Audit the plot logic below. Check event causality, character motives and capabilities, what each character knows, pivotal coincidences, consequences, and turn conditions. Distinguish definite contradictions, possible gaps, and questions requiring more canon, then propose the least disruptive fixes:

description.zh: 追踪时间、地点、物品、伤势与称谓
description.en: Track time, place, objects, injuries, and naming

prompt.zh: 请核对以下小说材料的时间线和连续性。追踪日期时刻、事件先后、行程耗时、人物位置、年龄称谓、物品状态、伤势、天气和已确认设定；用对照表列出冲突位置、证据与建议：
prompt.en: Check the timeline and continuity of the fiction below. Track dates and times, event order, travel duration, character location, age and forms of address, object state, injuries, weather, and established canon. Use a comparison table showing conflicting passages, evidence, and recommendations:

description.zh: 区分类型套路、情节雷同与文本复制
description.en: Separate tropes, plot similarity, and copying

prompt.zh: 请对以下小说执行原创性风险筛查。检查是否存在与已知作品高度雷同的角色组合、情节链、关键场景、独特设定、表达顺序或连续文本。区分公共母题、类型套路、一般相似、实质性情节雷同、近似改写和逐字复制。每项必须列出本稿片段、候选来源、来源定位、相似点、关键差异和证据强度；无法检索或没有可靠来源时明确说明，不得凭印象指控抄袭：
prompt.en: Screen the following fiction for originality risks. Look for unusually similar character combinations, event sequences, signature scenes, distinctive premises, expression order, or continuous wording. Distinguish common motifs, genre conventions, general similarity, substantial plot overlap, close paraphrase, and verbatim copying. For every finding, show the manuscript passage, candidate source and location, similarities, material differences, and evidence strength. State clearly when search or reliable sources are unavailable; never allege plagiarism from impression alone:

zh: 每天「20:00」校阅当天新增章节的错别字、标点和病句
每周一「09:00」汇总上周稿件中反复出现的语言问题
每周三「19:30」核对新增章节的人物动机与信息边界
每周五「20:00」审计全稿时间线、地点和物品连续性
每周日「16:00」复核本周修订项是否关闭且未引入新错误
每月 1 日「10:00」汇总 AI 腔与原创性风险，并生成优先修订清单
en: Every day at 20:00, proofread the day's new chapter for typos, punctuation, and faulty sentences
Every Monday at 09:00, summarize recurring prose issues from the previous week's manuscript
Every Wednesday at 19:30, check character motivation and knowledge boundaries in new chapters
Every Friday at 20:00, audit the manuscript timeline, locations, and object continuity
Every Sunday at 16:00, verify that this week's revisions are resolved without new errors
On the 1st of every month at 10:00, summarize AI-like prose and originality risks and produce a prioritized revision list
